question: Padma Shri Award 2022 was given to whom among the following Kuchipudi dancers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padmaja Reddy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri Award 2022 **was given to **Padmaja Reddy,** a **Kuchipudi dancer** from Telangana.
 
• She presents ballets that explore modern **societal challenges and mythological themes.**
 
• She directed the Kuchipudi visual dance style known as **Kakatiyam.**
 
• **Padma Shri Award **is one of the **highest civilian awards** given by the Government of India.
 
• **Kuchipudi **is a classical dance form of** Andhra Pradesh**, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pallavi Krishnan** is a Bharatanatyam dancer.

 
 
• She is from **Kerala.**
 
 
 
• **Sunanda Nair **is a Mohiniyattam dancer.
 
 
• She is also from** Kerala.**
 
 
 
• **Sitara Devi **was a Kathak dancer from** Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
• She passed away in** 2014.**
